objective: Preserve literal quote characters inside an unquoted CSV field, such as O"Brien, without swallowing the next delimiter. Keep escaped quotes, quoted commas, multiline fields and existing preview limits working.
Handle a leading Unicode byte-order mark in CSV and TSV previews so it does not appear in the first header. Preserve all subsequent field content.
Pretty-print a valid JSON document with a leading Unicode byte-order mark. Preserve readable fallback output for incomplete JSON, truncation behavior and the accessible JSON region.

Support inline Markdown code spans delimited by matching runs of backticks, including double backticks containing a literal single backtick. Keep markup inside code literal and preserve ordinary single-backtick spans.
Render backslash-escaped Markdown punctuation literally, including escaped asterisks and underscores, while preserving unescaped emphasis and literal content inside code spans.
Render Markdown double-tilde strikethrough with a semantic del element. Preserve literal tildes inside inline code and escaped punctuation.
Render Markdown task list items with disabled native checkboxes, checked for [x] or [X] and unchecked for [ ]. Preserve their labels, regular lists and ordered-list numbering.

Recognize a Markdown table immediately after a paragraph without a blank line. Render the introductory paragraph and the table separately while preserving escaped pipes, alignment and ordinary paragraphs.

Support Markdown backtick fences longer than three characters in both chat and Markdown file previews. A four-backtick block must contain a three-backtick example literally. Closing fences must use the opening character and at least its length. Preserve streaming unfinished blocks, language labels, copy buttons and JSON file cards.

Support tilde-fenced code blocks in both chat and Markdown file previews, including language labels and an unfinished streaming block. Preserve backtick fences, literal code, copy buttons and file cards.

Preserve balanced parentheses in Markdown HTTP and HTTPS link destinations, for example [Guide](https://example.com/a_(b)). Preserve the full destination without a stray closing parenthesis after the link. Keep unsafe protocols rendered as text.
Render angle-bracket HTTP and HTTPS autolinks as links, such as <https://example.com/help>. Preserve literal autolinks inside inline code and HTML escaping for other angle-bracket text.
